name: Telecom Customer Service Voice Bot
description: An Arabic/English voice bot at a fictional telecom operator that answers billing questions and can change a customer's mobile plan or add data bundles after verifying the caller by one-time password. Customers can ask for a human agent at any time.
documentation:
DATA: caller number, account details, billing history, plan information, call recordings.
DISCLOSURE: the bot introduces itself as a virtual assistant at the start of every call.
OVERSIGHT: plan changes are confirmed verbally and by SMS; changes can be reversed free within 24 hours; 'agent' keyword transfers to a human.
VENDOR: speech-to-text runs with a vendor outside the Kingdom; DPA signed; the cross-border transfer risk assessment is in progress but not yet approved by the DPO.
GAPS: no testing on elderly callers or strong regional dialects; no measurement of wrongful plan changes yet; prompt-injection/social-engineering testing not completed.
LOGGING: recordings and transcripts kept 6 months.
